notes: SHIP v1.14.441 - THE ONE CONTEXT FOLLOWS THE SURFACE THE TECHNICIAN IS LOOKING AT. THE REPORT: rack preview not working, and a large empty non-rendering rack area on the rack detail. WHAT IT WAS NOT. It was not a legacy rack renderer - there is none in that path. It was not the async three.js guard in rackElevation_ensure3D - THREE is already loaded, so that branch never executes. Both were investigated, instrumented and ruled out before anything was edited, and both are recorded here because the first two diagnoses were wrong and the method that corrected them is the durable part. WHAT IT IS. Opening a rack detail does not remove #bw-mount from the DOM: the detail renders into #wk-deploy INSIDE #pg-work. Build's bounded re-arm from .391 - twelve tries at 400ms, about five seconds - therefore keeps firing AFTER the detail opens, and every retry runs releaseOthers and disposes the detail's mount. Traced through RackEngine: releaseOthers(bw-mount) 0 then acquireOrDefer true, releaseOthers(reh3dMount) 1 then acquireOrDefer false, releaseOthers(bw-mount) 1 then acquireOrDefer false, repeating. Build WINS every exchange and logs webglcontextlost re-arming three times in a clean harness run, and #reh3dMount ends at canvas=NONE. The rack detail never drew at all, and the CSS held its 60vh mount open and painted black over a U1-U48 rail that .is-3d had hidden. THE FIX IS .405's GUARD, EXTENDED TO THE SURFACE IT MISSED. v1.14.405 fixed exactly this class for the Forge aisle and wrote down the general rule - a retry loop that outlives a navigation to another WebGL surface is a STALE CALLBACK, and the guard must ask am I still the surface the technician is looking at, not is my mount still in the DOM. It guarded the aisle and stopped there. The rack detail has the identical property, so the same guard at the same place in draw() now also defers on body.ops-detail, which deploy_showRackDetail sets and showMode clears. One condition, in a guard that already existed, covering the first attempt and all twelve re-arms. No scene change - RACK SCENE LOCK untouched. No change to .434's reclaim barrier. Nothing deleted. Bare return, not a re-arm, matching the aisle branch: returning to Build re-renders it through nav_back to showMode to bw_render, so the mount comes back on its own with nothing left to fight. Not a silent failure - Build is off screen, so a toast would name a surface the technician is not looking at; the deferral is stated in the console. MEASURED BEFORE AND AFTER, same probe, same flow. Before: Build cold bw-mount LIVE 652x640; detail open bw-mount LIVE and reh3dMount canvas=NONE; back to Build LIVE. After: Build cold bw-mount LIVE; detail open bw-mount released and reh3dMount LIVE 592x1008; back to Build bw-mount LIVE 652x640. The rack detail draws for the first time and Build survives the round trip. TESTS: new spec 29-context-follows-surface, four tests. The rack detail holds a LIVE context and Build does not while the detail owns the screen; the context comes BACK to Build on return, because a guard that left Build permanently blank would trade one empty rack area for another; exactly one live context on all three surfaces; and the deferral is stated rather than silent. PROVEN TO CATCH THE DEFECT, not merely to pass: with the guard stashed the spec fails with 'the rack detail rendered NO rack'. Worth recording - the exactly-one-live-context test PASSED against the broken build, because Build held exactly one while the surface in front of the technician had none. Counting contexts never catches this; only asserting WHICH surface holds it does. That is the same bound-admits-the-defect shape that hid the .427 aisle defect for months. RUNS (phone-webkit): 29 = 4 passed. 02-build-forge alone = 14 passed. 08-forge-layout alone = 17 passed. 26 + 27 + 28 + 25 + 13 + 01 + 00 = 57 passed. GATES: 3 inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, 12 style blocks brace-balanced, 0 bare LF, three-stamp lockstep at .441. DEVICE-VERIFY, and this one genuinely needs the phone because the harness renders where iOS does not: open BUILD with an active rack and confirm the rack preview draws. Tap into the rack detail and confirm the rack draws there too, with no large black empty area. Come back to BUILD and confirm the preview is still drawing. PASS is a rack visible on all three. FAIL is any one of them blank.
